checks.open_task_contract: pass: each prompt asks for exactly the two goals the criteria check without printing the answer; one null quote per sample; other quotes verbatim; the language criterion is the blueprint wording.
checks.starters: pass: 36 fragments read in task context.
checks.names: Hugo, Selma and Ravi each in two exercises, Gijs, Dewi and Lars in one; all from the batch pool, no voice names or older cast.

diversity.within_batch: Twelve different scenes in six domains; recipients are friends, brother, colleague, boss, shop, classmate and neighbour. Sample errors vary (verb ending, infinitive, 'niet' for 'geen', word order, separable particle, 'hebben' for 'zijn', article, adjective ending, agreement, possessive, missing article).
diversity.set_assembly: The author's four sets work; three different people per set. The two funny items are in different sets.

meaning.situation_summary: A very large parcel arrives at the learner's home, the neighbour sees it and asks what is in the box; the picture shows a woman kneeling beside the huge open box with one spoon at the bottom.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Tell the neighbour what is in the box and that the box is big.
meaning.coherence_explanation: Every goal follows from the prompt and from a visible fact in the one picture; no off-page event is needed.
meaning.contrivance_check: Original wording had the neighbour bring the parcel (so she stood beside the learner and could see inside). Now she only sees the delivery from outside and texts, so she does not know the contents; the single spoon in the enormous box is the joke.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: The neighbour is in her own home and curious; a message is the natural way to answer.
meaning.tone_reason: One ordinary spoon alone in an enormous box.
meaning.final_source_recheck: Meaning pass repeated on the final proposed bytes and the rebuilt blind packet.

meaning.situation_summary: Classmate Lars has gone home and asks whether anything lies on his chair; the learner, still in the empty classroom, sees a blue scarf on a chair.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Tell Lars what lies on his chair and ask if he comes to the lesson tomorrow, so he can get it back.
meaning.coherence_explanation: Every goal follows from the prompt and from a visible fact in the one picture; no off-page event is needed.
meaning.contrivance_check: The author asked for his address with no reason, which is odd and a privacy request; the replacement question follows naturally because the scarf can be handed back tomorrow. Only the scarf lies there.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Lars is at home; the learner is in the classroom and answers his message.
meaning.tone_reason: A forgotten scarf in a classroom is everyday.
